integrity: The complete analytical argument and independent exact-arithmetic commutant checks are supplied; novelty is subject to the stated bounded source comparison. No external independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unit-weight complete bipartite graphs with both part sizes at least two.
Exactly one marked vertex and a real diagonal potential.
No claim about generic weighted graphs, multiple marks, smallest nonzero mixing eigenvalues, or instantaneous uniformity.
Exact algebraic proof is supplemented by, but does not depend on, finite rational computations.
title: Single-site detuning produces three exact rank regimes in complete bipartite quantum walks
